over-confidence-on-vague-tickets.description: Diagnoses a defect category from a vague/minimal ticket with no customer-supplied supporting evidence; all support is pipeline-generated probe output.

conflict-over-conservatism.description: A single conflicting log vetoes every hypothesis, discarding uncontested evidence (config diffs, audit failures).

out-of-scope-scoping-gap.description: Abstention addresses only the publishing defect; non-publishing complaints in the same ticket go unacknowledged.
